suppress.notes: CVE-2026-116593 affects Kafka Connect's connector-plugins configuration-validation REST endpoint. The affected Connect endpoint is not included in kafka-clients; Dependency-Check's product-level match against this client artifact is a false positive. See https://kafka.apache.org/community/cve-list/.

Kafka fixes these issues only in 4.2.2, 4.3.2, and 4.4.0. The current shared Kafka 3.9 line cannot be remediated without a major Kafka 4 upgrade, which is deferred to the separate dependency-modernization effort. Revisit this suppression when that work is scheduled. See https://kafka.apache.org/community/cve-list/.
